university: Tunku Abdul Rahman University of Management and Technology

requirements.general_text: Academic Requirement Bachelor’s Degree in Economics or related field with minimum CGPA 2.75; OR Bachelor’s Degree in Economics or related field with CGPA 2.50 (subject to internal assessment); OR Bachelor’s Degree in Economics or related field with CGPA 2.00 plus at least 5 years of relevant working experience (subject to internal assessment); OR Non-related degree holders must complete prerequisite courses and meet CGPA requirements. English Language Requirements Malaysian students: MUET Band 3.5 / IELTS 5.0 / CEFR High B1 / TOEFL iBT 40 or equivalent; OR exemption if prior studies were conducted in English. International students: IELTS 5.0 / CEFR High B1 / TOEFL iBT 40 or equivalent; OR exemption if prior studies were conducted in English.
